Name: Greenhouse20x20
Author: sirloinmeatt
Description:
[i]Tested on SDV 1.3.28 / Windows[/i]

Takes the regular Greenhouse and expands it to 20x20. Perfect fit for Iridium sprinklers and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2428]Prismatic Sprinklers[/url] if you put some sprinklers on the outside rim.

Ambient Lighting is removed so you'll want torches inside. Best used on a new game.

[b]Requires:[/b]
Latest SMAPI

[b]Install:[/b]
Unzip to Mods folder

[b]Uninstall:[/b]
Delete Greenhouse20x20 from Mods folder



Special thanks to Pathoschild and the Wiki.
